data.body: Disposition review (2026-09-08): current origin/main has already absorbed the real fixture-heal follow-up work this ticket collected. Evidence: tests/unit/test_fixture_heal_heldout.py now covers non-default cap reservation, incomplete admissions not accruing strikes, unminable drift precedence, skipped-unbalanced and failed-reproduce production attempter classifications, empty usage rows failing closed on budget, cross-sweep ledger reset, UnpriceableRun estimate charging, charge_estimate estimated rows, and live criteria heal CLI summary output. tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_ledger.py covers charge_estimate/reserve ledger accounting. docs/exit-codes.md now documents criteria eval/heal contracts including --require-live and --changed-since null-ref behavior. The remaining perf/empty-gap items are explicitly non-blocking deferrals, not defects that invalidate current behavior. No new code change is warranted; closing obsolete as mooted by already-merged R-4 work rather than reopening churn.
